title: microsorum irioides
intro: Microsorum irioides, commonly known as Tuckahoe or Fishbone Fern, is a type of creeping fern native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum irioides include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
